nodes.name: Execute Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives analytics payload from the main query pipeline: {query_hash, category, match_score, response_ms, docs_matched, was_answered, session_id, rejection_layer, created_at}

nodes.name: Normalize & Hash
nodes.notes: Computes SHA-256 hash of normalized query, validates all fields, formats for PostgreSQL insertion

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO query_logs (query_hash, category, match_score, response_ms, docs_matched, was_answered, session_id, rejection_layer)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.query_hash }}',
  '{{ $json.category }}',
  {{ $json.match_score }},
  {{ $json.response_ms }},
  ARRAY[{{ ($json.docs_matched || []).map(d => "'" + String(d).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  {{ $json.was_answered }},
  '{{ $json.session_id }}'::uuid,
  {{ $json.rejection_layer ? "'" + $json.rejection_layer + "'" : 'NULL' }}
)

nodes.name: Insert into query_logs
nodes.notes: Inserts anonymized analytics record into PostgreSQL. Uses parameterized query to prevent SQL injection.

nodes.name: Has matched docs?
nodes.notes: Only update document_usage if documents were actually matched

nodes.name: Split Documents
nodes.notes: Creates one item per document for the upsert loop

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO document_usage (document_name, reference_count, last_referenced)
SELECT unnest(ARRAY[{{ ($json.docs_matched || []).map(d => "'" + String(d).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[]), 1, NOW()
ON CONFLICT (document_name)
DO UPDATE SET
  reference_count = document_usage.reference_count + 1,
  last_referenced = NOW()

nodes.name: Upsert document_usage
nodes.notes: Increments reference_count for each matched document or creates new entry

nodes.name: Log Complete
nodes.notes: Silent completion — this workflow runs async and never blocks the student response
